name: Spam Comment Remover
author: Sahil Dadwal

sections.description:
Spam Comment Remover is a lightweight, zero-setup WordPress plugin that automatically stops spam comments and silently removes them.

Features:

  • Universal spam detection engine
  • Blocks hidden links, disguised URLs, BBCode, anchor tags
  • Blocks gibberish, AI-generated text patterns, random strings
  • Auto-deletes pending and spam comments after activation
  • Keeps admin-approved comments safe
  • No conflict with any plugin or theme
  • Removes “Website” field from the comment form
  • Fully automated system — no settings required

Perfect for bloggers, businesses, portfolio sites, and WooCommerce stores.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/spam-comment-remover
  2. Activate through Plugins page
  3. That’s all — spam removal starts instantly
